Dear [Miss Phillpotts](/person/1171),
It seems hardly fair to have kept your paper several days, when the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52) is obliged to 'draw a line' against the numerous Missionary Papers it might have, but I wanted to show it to [Miss Crawley](/person/382) - who you know, as well as [Miss Morshead](/person/28) was one of the first Sisters.
She begged to keep a copy of it, and I think it would be most advisable to publish it. I was thinking of sending it to the [Literary Churchman](/periodical/76)

Yours truly

C M Yonge
Looking again at your note I see you design it for the [Net](/periodical/94)as the next choice, so here it is.
